protocol.audit: actual-frame raw/rounded target and whole-context heavy geometry, all H geometry, original-observation motion, baseline endpoint differences and every failure
protocol.bridge: existing post-H repair exactly once on reconstructed bound topology; exact original nm starts preflighted
protocol.enrollment: ALL24 source contexts x ALL3 predeclared H arms; no new seed/angle/iteration search
protocol.invariants: heavy coordinates remain exact through H transport, original whole-system parameters unchanged; unchanged arm must reproduce both saved endpoints exactly
protocol.limits: no emergency reflection, coordinate restoration, native accuracy, public candidate/PDB publication or production qualification
protocol.physics: original no-solvent saved System/State/integrator; only original positional k divided10 in phase2, original anchors/vrefs unchanged
